title: ScotchSecure
tagline: Hot scams are super draining, and they're simply not cute. It's time we learn (and earn) about cybersecurity with the ScotchSecure Spicy Simulation for creatives, music artists, sportspeople and their fans.
description:
ScotchSecure represents a hot topic - cybersecurity. Quite frankly, scams are not cute. Nobody wants to be drained, nobody wants to be thirsty. SS is a dynamic project focused on revolutionising cybersecurity education through interactive learning and engagement with influencers. Powered by Chiliz token and Celo MiniPay, it provides an immersive experience where users can learn by doing, simulating real-world cyber threats to understand how to protect themselves. Key features include 'Dynamic' for seamless sign-in experiences, 'Celo' for secure artist merchandise payments, and 'Chiliz', rewarding users with points for completing cybersecurity tasks. 

The project fosters a vibrant community or 'Fandom', united by common interests, aiming to prevent scams and enhance digital safety as a collective. It empowers users to invest in what they believe through 'Equity' and utilises social media platforms like Twitter for widespread outreach. 

ScotchSecure not only connects fans with their favourite celebrities and sports stars, who help educate on cybersecurity, but also integrates Mainnet and Testnet (Spicy) for Chiliz, allowing direct engagement with fans while promoting online safety. The project's essence is to make cybersecurity education accessible, enjoyable, and highly interactive, ensuring users are well-prepared to navigate the digital world securely.

Learn and earn with Celo MiniPay and Chiliz Token 'LN' cybersecurity tokens.
how_its_made:
Made initially with Celo's composer to implement MiniPay then new pages were created for the game challenges. Upon completion of the task, users can mint a NFT which is redeemable against artist merch. 

Chiliz - Fan Utility Projects or SportFi Projects
Created a platform that gamifies cybersecurity education through sports or fan engagement. For example, you could create cybersecurity challenges themed around sports events or teams. Users could earn Fan Tokens for completing cybersecurity quizzes or challenges, which could then be used for rewards like exclusive content, merchandise discounts, or special event access. This approach aligns with the Chiliz emphasis on sports and entertainment, and by incorporating Fan Tokens, you directly utilize a core Chiliz asset.

Dynamic - Best crypto-enabled app
Created a user-friendly cybersecurity education platform that seamlessly integrates crypto functionalities without overwhelming the user. Utilize Dynamic's toolkit for authentication, authorization, onboarding, and user management. This could include token-gated access to advanced courses or content, using crypto as a reward system for course completion, and ensuring a smooth onboarding experience for users unfamiliar with crypto.

Celo - Best Dapp for MiniPay
Developed a mobile-friendly cybersecurity education app that integrates with MiniPay for transactions. Considering Celo's focus on stablecoins and mobile-first approach, you could implement a reward system where users earn stablecoins for completing courses or challenges. These rewards could be used within the app for purchasing premium content or could be cashed out, providing real value to the educational experience.
